name: 44 redacted-provider payment cardholder IDs seized in 2022

attribution.legal_posture: The affidavit alleges probable cause that funds in these redacted-provider accounts were derived from DPRK IT-worker employment and involved in sanctions-evasion/money-laundering activity

caveats: Registration of an identity supplies a registration fact; knowing participation requires case-specific evidence.
The service provider and account-holder emails are redacted; the numeric IDs are useful only as historical legal-document indicators.
This record preserves the legal document's posture; guilt remains bounded by the stated proceeding.

infrastructure.note: Values are reproduced only as a grouped, review-only legal-document indicator set. They are not current account identifiers and are not attributed to individual account holders.
